title: Reliable Evaluations for Natural Language Inference based on a Unified Cross-dataset Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Natural Language Inference (NLI) models trained on a single dataset (SNLI) across 14 out-of-domain NLI datasets to measure their reliance on superficial textual clues (such as negation words) rather than true semantic understanding, alongside assessing various debiasing methods like adversarial training, residual fitting, and instance weighting.
